message.Title: Generally Available: Claude Opus 5 on Azure Databricks

Body.Content:
Azure Databricks now supports Anthropic Claude Opus 5 through AI Model Serving. Claude Opus 5 is Anthropic's latest model for advanced reasoning, coding, agentic workflows, and professional knowledge work. 

Claude Opus 5 is designed for complex tasks requiring deep reasoning, long-horizon planning, and software development assistance. Customers can use Claude Opus 5 in Azure Databricks to build AI applications and agents on enterprise data.

Learn more.
